name: homelab-proxmox
description: Proxmox VE + Terraform + Ansible + monitoring (Prometheus/Grafana). Targets sysadmins running infrastructure-as-code on a personal or small-team Proxmox cluster. Filters out app/UI/mobile-only skills (React, Next.js, Flutter, mobile-release, frontend-design, conversion optimization). Bundles ZERO marketplace plugins at v1 — Terraform-specific plugins will be added incrementally as they are validated in real production use. Rules from the foundation are path-gated (react.md activates on .tsx files only, etc.) so they remain inert on a Terraform/Ansible repo.

recommendedVendorSkills.rationale: Comprehensive Terraform/OpenTofu patterns (the de-facto community skill)
recommendedVendorSkills.condition: always (Terraform is core to this preset)
if using Pulumi instead of Terraform

recommendedVendorSkills.rationale: Grafana, LGTM stack for monitoring and observability

outOfScope: Application development (use the nextjs preset or a backend-language preset)
Mobile companions (use a flutter or swift preset — community contributions wanted)
Cloud infrastructure beyond Proxmox/OPNsense — see roadmap for AWS, GCP, Azure presets
